nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Structural normative models used warped Bayesian linear regression; functional connectivity models used Bayesian linear regression with likelihood warping.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: For the structural data, we used a publicly shared repository of pre- trained normative models that were estimated on approximately 58,000 subjects using a warped Bayesian Linear Regression algorithm ( Fraza et al., 2021 ). In addition to normative models of brain structure, we also expanded our repository by estimating normative models of brain functional connectivity (resting- state brain networks, Yeo- 17 and Smith- 10) using the same algorithm (Bayesian Linear Regression) as the structural models. Bayesian Linear Regression (BLR) with likelihood warping was used to predict each Yeo- 17 network pair from a vector of covariates (age, sex, mean_FD, site).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Normative model formulation; Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Functional Brain Networks Normative Modeling

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Response variables include cortical thickness and subcortical volume (structural), surface area, and resting-state functional connectivity between large-scale networks.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: We used the aparcstats2table and asegstats2table functions to extract the cortical thickness and subcortical volume from each region in the Destrieux atlas and Freesurfer subcortical atlas. Normative models of surface area were also added to the same repository Supplementary file 2. In addition to normative models of brain structure, we also expanded our repository by estimating normative models of brain functional connectivity (resting- state brain networks, Yeo- 17 and Smith- 10) using the same algorithm (Bayesian Linear Regression) as the structural models.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Rutherford2023.pdf.md: 'Raw' input data; Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Normative model formulation

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age (modeled with cubic spline basis expansion for non-linear effects), Sex, Site, Euler number (structural), Mean Framewise Displacement (functional).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: The covariates used to train the structural normative models included age, sex, data quality metric (Euler number), and site. ... functional normative models ... included age, sex, data quality metric (mean framewise displacement), and site. ... consisting of a B- spline basis expansion (cubic spline with 5 evenly spaced knots) to model non- linear effects of age
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Methods / Normative model formulation & Appendix 1 / Functional Brain Networks Normative Modeling
